name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.flatImage_eq
typeText:
∀ (γ : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance) {A : Type} (hv : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.Valid γ)
  [inst : Fintype.{0} A]
  (I :
    DisequalityDispersion.Interpretation (Fin (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.m γ))
      (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.arity γ) A)
  (d : A),
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.flatImage γ hv I d)
    (DisequalityDispersion.filteredTriples (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.xv γ hv)
      (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.yv γ hv) (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.outTerm γ hv)
      (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.testTerms γ hv) I)

source.code:
/-- **Image preservation** for every interpretation. -/
theorem flatImage_eq (hv : γ.Valid) [Fintype A] (I : Interpretation (Fin γ.m) γ.arity A)
    (d : A) :
    γ.flatImage hv I d = filteredTriples (γ.xv hv) (γ.yv hv) (γ.outTerm hv) (γ.testTerms hv) I := by
  classical
  have ht := (γ.valid_iff.mp hv).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  ext o
  simp only [flatImage, filteredTriples, validAssignments, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter,
    Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨a, b⟩, ⟨hdef, htest⟩, rfl⟩
    have hb := γ.defines_unique hv I a d b hdef
    subst hb
    refine ⟨a, (γ.flatTests_iff hv I a d).mp htest, ?_⟩
    simp only
    rw [γ.bval_extend hv I a d γ.t ht]
    rfl
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨a, γ.extend I a d⟩, ⟨γ.extend_defines hv I a d, (γ.flatTests_iff hv I a d).mpr ha⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only
    rw [γ.bval_extend hv I a d γ.t ht]
    rfl
